options.label: Render resolution
options.description: How many times the console's own resolution the game is drawn at. Higher is sharper and costs GPU time; 1x suits the smaller boards.

options.label: Console video mode
options.description: The console's own video settings, as a game reads them: widescreen games draw 16:9 only when the console is set to it, and some offer 480p.

options.label: Aspect ratio
options.description: The picture's shape on screen. Auto follows the game (16:9 when the console is set to widescreen).

options.label: Upscaling filter
options.description: How a picture smaller than the screen is scaled up. Snapdragon GSR is sharper and costs a little GPU time.

options.label: FXAA
options.description: Smooths jagged edges over each frame.

options.label: Shader compilation
options.description: In the background, a new effect can be missing for a moment instead of the game pausing while it compiles.

notes: Every option is a hakux argument (native/core/options.h and native/app/linux_main.c, hakuX-lr retroforge-standalone): no settings file, so the weekly key-drift check has nothing to look for (no .github/emu-sources.json entry).

video= is the console's XC_VIDEO_FLAGS word (hex): 0x10000 widescreen, 0x80000 480p (native/kernel/kernel.h NC_VIDEO_*). Unchosen, the core's default applies (render scale 1x, asynchronous shaders on, video flags the core's).
Not offered: 720p and 1080i (more GPU than the small boards have) and the console's language and network (the core's defaults: English, no cable).
